_**Agent (copilot/o3-mini)**_

The error message

  "0 != 204800 Cannot reduce scatter gradients whose size is not same as the params"

means that during the zero‐stage 3 gradient reduction DeepSpeed expects every trainable parameter to have a gradient tensor whose number of elements exactly matches the “DS” (DeepSpeed) parameter size. In your case one of the parameters (for example one in your “prompt_pool”) is not receiving any gradient (its grad is empty or None) even though its ds_numel is nonzero. This mismatch causes the reduce scatter routine to throw a RuntimeError.

A common cause is that a parameter is “unused” in the forward pass of your model (or its gradient is not computed) so that its grad is left as None. DeepSpeed’s zero optimizer (especially in stage 3 with overlapping gradient partition/communication) requires that every parameter has a gradient (even if it is all zeros).

One fix is to “patch” the model’s backward so that before DeepSpeed proceeds to reduce gradients you ensure every parameter that requires gradients gets a dummy (zero‐filled) grad if none was computed.

For example, before calling backward or immediately after loss.backward() (or inside your custom training step), add code like this:

  for param in model.parameters():
   if param.requires_grad and (param.grad is None or param.grad.numel() == 0):
    param.grad = torch.zeros_like(param)

By forcing a zero gradient in place of a missing one, the size of the gradient will always match the expected ds_numel, and the reduce scatter operation will not fail.

Make sure to insert this fallback in a place that runs on every backward update (for example, right after loss.backward() and before any DeepSpeed gradient reduction calls). This change is only needed in a situation where some parameters are “unused” in the forward pass. Alternatively, if the parameter should always contribute to the loss, you might review the forward computation to ensure it is actually used.

After applying this change the bug should be resolved.
